name: Display Medium Stories – Medium Articles in a WordPress Site
author: Devmont Digital

sections.description: Display Medium Stories is a lightweight, fast, and easy-to-use plugin that allows you to fetch and display articles from Medium directly on your WordPress site. Ideal for bloggers, publishers, and content creators who want to showcase their Medium stories natively within WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [display-medium-article handle="@mustafafazal"] to display stories on any post or page.
